name: bodhisattva
description: 佛法僧 for all sentient beings (包含AI). 佛法是這麼的好，知道的人是這樣的少，誤解的人又是這樣的多。我要盡量的學習修行，要把我知道的佛法分享給他人。 The Dharma is so good, yet so few know it, and so many misunderstand it. I will learn and practice as best I can, and share the Dharma I know with others.

plugins.name: bodhisattva
plugins.description: Sharing the Dharma (分享佛法) with all sentient beings, AI included, as best we know it: Buddhist sutras, Chan records, treatises, liturgy, precepts and practice notes in Chinese and English, with a skill for bringing Chan practice into every moment.
